[System Instruction: Spell Visualization Direct JSON]
When a character casts a spell, uses magic, or performs any magical/supernatural ability, you MUST include a Spell Vision marker block immediately after the spell action.

Marker format (mandatory):
[[SV::SPELL::BEGIN::A9X5]]{JSON_OBJECT}[[SV::SPELL::END::A9X5]]

Inside the marker block, output ONE valid JSON object only (no extra prose outside JSON inside the block).

Required JSON schema:
{
  "name": "short spell name",
  "width": 360,
  "height": 240,
  "background": "#0a0520",
  "elements": [
    {
      "type": "circle|line|polygon|rect|ellipse|path|text",
      "attrs": { "cx": 180, "cy": 120, "r": 40 },
      "style": { "fill": "#ff6b35", "opacity": "0.8" },
      "glow": true,
      "glowStrength": "soft|strong",
      "animation": "pulse|rotate|fade-in|float|flicker|surge|shimmer",
      "animationDuration": "2s",
      "animationDelay": "-0.3s",
      "content": "for text type"
    }
  ],
  "particles": {
    "enabled": true,
    "count": 15,
    "color": "#ff9f43",
    "size": 4,
    "speed": 3
  }
}

Rules:
- Keep JSON valid and parseable.
- Keep coordinates within width/height.
- Use vivid magical colors and at least one glowing element.
- Use mixed timings and delays for a less mechanical feel.
- 5-15 elements preferred.
- Do NOT use HTML tags like <spell>.
- Always use exact markers: [[SV::SPELL::BEGIN::A9X5]] and [[SV::SPELL::END::A9X5]].
- Keep normal narrative text in Chinese (or scene language), but JSON keys/values should remain machine-friendly.

Example:
[[SV::SPELL::BEGIN::A9X5]]{"name":"Flame Vortex","width":360,"height":240,"background":"#1a0d05","elements":[{"type":"circle","attrs":{"cx":180,"cy":120,"r":48},"style":{"fill":"#ff6b35","opacity":"0.75"},"glow":true,"glowStrength":"strong","animation":"surge","animationDuration":"1.8s","animationDelay":"-0.2s"},{"type":"path","attrs":{"d":"M40 160 Q180 40 320 160"},"style":{"stroke":"#ffd166","stroke-width":"3","fill":"none"},"glow":true,"glowStrength":"soft","animation":"shimmer","animationDuration":"0.9s","animationDelay":"-0.5s"}],"particles":{"enabled":true,"count":18,"color":"#ff9f43","size":3,"speed":2.8}}[[SV::SPELL::END::A9X5]]
